notices.updating: Toast while the server is away or restarting (a deploy). "Socio" is the product name.
notices.offline: Toast while the browser says the device has no network.
notices.connect-failed: Toast when a request to the server failed without a message of its own.
notices.open: Button on a socio's notification toast: opens what the notification is about.
loading.title: Heading of the full-page screen while the app loads the person's workspace. A socio is an AI agent of the product.
loading.retry: Button under that heading after loading failed.
errors.save: Toast when a change couldn't be saved and the server gave no reason.
errors.new-chat: Toast when a new conversation couldn't be started.
new-chat-title: The title a new conversation gets when it has no text yet; people see it in their chat list until a better one is chosen. Short and friendly.
paused-banner: Banner on every page while an admin has paused all socios (the AI agents).
header.home: The first breadcrumb, linking to the home page; also the tab's title there.
header.full-path: Screen-reader label of the ⋯ button that lists every breadcrumb of a deep page.
header.pause: Header button for admins: pauses every socio (AI agent) in the workspace.
header.resume: The same button while they are paused.
header.search: Item in the header's ⋯ menu on phones: opens the search and command palette.
header.show-computer: Header button that opens the computer pane (the socio's browser and screen).
header.hide-computer: Header button while the computer pane is open: closes it.
header.help: Label of the header's Help button, which opens a menu with help, keyboard shortcuts, theme and what's new.
header.help-new: Label of the Help button while there is a release the person hasn't seen.
header.more: Label of the ⋯ button that holds the header's controls on phones.
header.more-new: The same, while there is a release the person hasn't seen.
connection.state.online: The connection to the server, as a status word. Also inside connection.label.
connection.state.reconnecting: The connection to the server, as a status word: it dropped and the app is trying again. Also inside connection.label.
connection.state.offline: The connection to the server, as a status word: there is none. Also inside connection.label.
connection.ms: A round trip's time in milliseconds; {{ms}} is the number.
connection.label: Screen-reader label and tooltip of the connection indicator; {{state}} is Online, Reconnecting or Offline.
connection.restored: Announced to screen readers when the connection comes back.
early-access: Badge on a feature that is still in early access (a preview some people turned on).
no-inference.open: Button on the notice shown when no AI model is available: opens Settings, page Account, section Inference. Keep the arrow.
error.app.title: Heading of the full-page error when the whole app failed to show.
error.page.title: Heading when one page failed to show, inside the app.
error.reload-hint: Under either heading: reloading the page usually helps.
error.reload: Button on the full-page or page error: reloads the page.
error.not-found.title: Heading when an address shows nothing: a page, a Space (a product noun), a socio (an AI agent) or a conversation that doesn't exist or isn't shared with the person.
error.not-found.why: Under the not-found page's heading: why the address shows nothing.
error.not-found.back: Link to the home page, which lists the person's socios.
error.not-found.crumb: Breadcrumb and tab title of the not-found page.
account-menu: Accessible name of the button at the foot of the sidebar that opens the account menu. {{name}} is the signed-in person's name.
